name: My Hero Academia: Vigilantes
description: After a life-changing incident, timid college student Koichi Haimawari accepts an offer from revered vigilante Knuckleduster to train as his protégé.

videos.title: I'm Here
videos.overview: Koichi is convinced he'll never manage to become a hero, until he meets someone with an odd take on justice.

videos.title: Takeoff
videos.overview: Some people frown upon vigilante activities, but the least they could do is remember The Crawler's name.

videos.title: Bee
videos.overview: The drug Trigger is wreaking havoc all over town, but figuring out who's dealing it is easier said than done.

videos.title: Top Runner
videos.overview: What happens when pro heroes and vigilantes target the same villain? Is it possible to work as a team?

videos.title: Judgment
videos.overview: Koichi and Pop each find themselves considerably influenced by various events from their pasts.

videos.title: Crossing Lines
videos.overview: Hachisuka tries manipulating Stendhal into fighting targets of her choosing, but can anyone control him?

videos.title: Makoto/Truth
videos.overview: Makoto offers to help a struggling Koichi with his studies, but she requests something surprising in return.

videos.title: Major
videos.overview: The American hero Captain Celebrity sets up shop in Japan, and it isn't long before trouble begins.

videos.title: Mom Descends!
videos.overview: Koichi's mother is in town, and he's willing to take drastic measures so that she'll let him stay in Tokyo.

videos.title: Event Announcement!
videos.overview: Pop receives a request to perform at an upcoming local event, and she finds herself in need of guidance.

videos.title: The Day Of
videos.overview: Preparing for Narufest proves to be an uphill battle. Will teamwork be what gets everyone to the finish line?

videos.title: Goodbye to Dad
videos.overview: There's trouble when the power goes out at Narufest, all while Knuckleduster fights a very personal battle.

videos.title: What a Man Takes with Him
videos.overview: Narufest turned out to be a huge success, but our vigilantes must decide whether it's time for some changes.

videos.title: Day-Tripping Down to Naniwa!
videos.overview: Pop gets invited to a mascot-idol event in Osaka, and Koichi accompanies her.

videos.title: Crabtastic Rampage!
videos.overview: Koichi and Pop get dragged into an incident when a Trigger dealer unleashes a cast of rampaging robotic crabs!

videos.title: Public and Private
videos.overview: Tsukauchi's investigation into the Trigger network has hit a wall, and he turns to All Might for advice.

videos.title: A Rational Man
videos.overview: Koichi's in double trouble, facing down a villain who might clobber him, and Eraser Head who might arrest him!

videos.title: The Man Returns
videos.overview: Koichi and Pop get into more Trigger trouble, and we learn where Knuckleduster has been.

videos.title: Rain and Clouds
videos.overview: Koichi encounters Eraser Head, who reminiscences about his student days.

videos.title: Glass Sky
videos.overview: When he was young, Aizawa's inexperience and awkward Quirk forced him to grapple with his self-esteem.

videos.title: A Sky with No Rain Left
videos.overview: When Aizawa was a younger, he and his friend Shirakumo were forced into a fight with a giant villain...

videos.title: Farewell Party!
videos.overview: With his legal problems soon to be taken care of, Captain Celebrity makes plans to return to America.

videos.title: Zero Hour
videos.overview: Captain Celebrity's farewell party begins, but the Scarred Man has some unpleasant surprises in store...

videos.title: Balloon Soul
videos.overview: Captain Celebrity tries to save the Sky Egg with Koichi's help, while reminiscing on what brought him here.

videos.title: This Is a Hero!
videos.overview: The Sky Egg falls as Captain Celebrity hits his limit, with only one person capable of saving the day...

videos.title: Graduation and Career Path
videos.overview: Captain Celebrity returns to the United States, and Koichi must decide what to do with his future.
